lines.t:
A type of <c:ffff00>stat<c> for <c:ffff00>head<c> and <c:ffff00>arm<c> <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>.

Measures how easily and accurately an <c:ffff00>attack<c> lands.
The higher the value, the higher the <c:ffff00>{{success_power}}<c>
and, slightly, the <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> dealt.

Only attack {{part|pl}} use this stat; other {{part|pl}} show "-".
